title: Step 1 - How to Prepare Data for Machine Learning: Training vs Test Sets

cues.en: Speaker: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，大家好。

cues.en: I hope you digested well the previous tutorial where we tackled this big, but yet important tool of our data pre-processing toolkit.
cues.zh: 希望你已充分消化上一堂課，那是資料前處理工具箱中比較大、但很重要的一項工具。

cues.en: Indeed. Now you know how to handle the case where you have some category called data in your data set which is a situation you will encounter many times
cues.zh: 現在，你已經知道如何處理資料集中的類別資料，這是在未來機器學習工作中，

cues.en: in your future machine learning career.
cues.zh: 經常會遇到的情況。

cues.en: And now we have two tools to cover.
cues.zh: 接著還有兩項工具。

cues.en: The first one being splitting the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 第一個是把資料集切分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And the second one being feature scaling.
cues.zh: 第二個是特徵縮放。

cues.en: So before we start, I'm about to answer one of the most frequently asked questions in the data science community; which is be ready for it.
cues.zh: 在開始之前，我要先回答資料科學社群最常見的問題之一，準備好了嗎？

cues.en: Do we have to apply feature scaling before splitting the data set into the training set and test set, or after?
cues.zh: 特徵縮放應該在切分訓練集與測試集之前做，還是之後？

cues.en: I've seen these questions many times, and you will find that question in many forums of the data science community.
cues.zh: 我看過這個問題很多次，社群的各種論壇也常會出現。

cues.en: Some people will say that we have to apply feature scaling before the split.
cues.zh: 有些人說要先縮放，再切分。

cues.en: Some people will say after the split, and now I'm about to reveal the right answer.
cues.zh: 有些人說先切分，現在就揭曉正確答案。

cues.en: There is only one right answer, which is by the way, totally obvious after you get the explanation.
cues.zh: 正確答案只有一個，而且了解原因後就會覺得很明顯。

cues.en: So, the answer is we have to apply feature scaling after splitting the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 答案是：必須先把資料切成訓練集與測試集，再進行特徵縮放。

cues.en: And now let me explain.
cues.zh: 現在說明原因。

cues.en: So first, just to make sure everybody understands let me explain the 'what' first, and then I'll explain the 'why'.
cues.zh: 先確保大家理解，我會先解釋「做什麼」，再解釋「為什麼」。

cues.en: So, of course splitting the data set into the training set and a test set consists of making two separate sets.
cues.zh: 切分訓練集與測試集，就是建立兩份獨立資料。

cues.en: One training set where you're gonna train your machinery model on existing observations, and one test set where you're going to evaluate the performance of your model on new observations.
cues.zh: 一份訓練集，用既有觀測值訓練模型；另一份測試集，用新的觀測值評估模型效能。

cues.en: And it's important to understand that these new observations are exactly like, you know some future data that you're gonna get and on which you're going to deploy your machine learning model.
cues.zh: 要了解，這些新觀測值，就像未來真正取得、準備部署模型來處理的新資料。

cues.en: Alright, so that's this first tool.
cues.zh: 這就是第一項工具。

cues.en: And now feature scaling simply consists of scaling all your variables, all your features, actually, to make sure they all take values in the same scale.
cues.zh: 特徵縮放則是調整所有變數，確切地說是所有特徵，確保它們位於相同尺度。

cues.en: And we do this so as to prevent one feature to dominate the other; which therefore would be neglected by the machine learning model.
cues.zh: 目的是避免某個特徵主導其他特徵，導致後者被模型忽略。

cues.en: Alright, so that's the 'what' for both of these tools.
cues.zh: 這就是兩項工具各自在做的事。

cues.en: Now, let me explain the 'why' we have to apply features scaling after splitting the data set into the training set and a test set. It's really obvious.
cues.zh: 接著說明，為什麼特徵縮放必須在切分後進行，原因其實很明顯。

cues.en: It is for this simple reason that the test set is supposed to be a brand new set on which you're going to evaluate your machine learning model.
cues.zh: 因為測試集應該是一份全新的資料，用來評估機器學習模型。

cues.en: So it's exactly like, you know, your training your machine learning model on your training set, and then later on, you know, after it is trained you're going to deploy it on new observations.
cues.zh: 就像先用訓練集訓練模型，訓練完成後，才把它部署到新的觀測資料上。

cues.en: So what this means is that the test set is something you're not supposed to work with for the training.
cues.zh: 因此，測試集不應該被拿來參與訓練。

cues.en: And feature scaling is, as you will see, a technique that will get the mean and the standard deviation of your feature, you know, in order to perform the scaling.
cues.zh: 而稍後會看到，特徵縮放需要取得特徵的平均數與標準差，才能完成縮放。

cues.en: So, if we apply feature scaling before the split then it will actually get the mean and the standard deviation of all the values,
cues.zh: 如果在切分之前做縮放，就會使用所有數值的平均數與標準差，

cues.en: including the ones in the test set.
cues.zh: 包括測試集中的數值。

cues.en: And since the test set is something you're not supposed to have, you know, like some future data in production, well you know, applying feature scaling on the original data set,
cues.zh: 但測試集應該像未來正式環境的資料，是訓練當下不應該知道的。因此，在原始資料集上

cues.en: before the split, would cause some what we call information leakage on the test set.
cues.zh: 先縮放再切分，就會造成所謂的測試集資訊洩漏。

cues.en: You know, we would grab some information from the test set, which we're not supposed to get, because it is supposed to be new data with new observations.
cues.zh: 我們取得了不該知道的測試集資訊，因為它本來應該是包含新觀測值的新資料。

cues.en: So remember this, the essential reason why you should not apply feature scaling before the split is to prevent information leakage
cues.zh: 所以請記住，不能在切分之前縮放的根本原因，是要避免

cues.en: on the test set; which you're not supposed to have until the training is done.
cues.zh: 測試集的資訊洩漏；這份資料應該在模型訓練完成後才使用。
